correctness.rationale: For a singleton valuation V(p)={x}, Delta p is false at w exactly when x lies in N(w) and |N(w)|>=2. The singleton queries recover each whole neighborhood of size at least two; all smaller neighborhoods give the same constant truth function on arbitrary truth sets. Hence equality of these signatures is equivalent to equality of the modal truth-set operators, which gives equal truth for arbitrary nesting by induction at the same valuation. Undirectedness means every edge except an isolated K2 edge is incident to a recovered row, so the recovered graph is exactly the kernel. Any lift adds a matching on its s isolates, and conversely; selecting and pairing vertices gives I_s. Choosing the isolate labels and forbidding K1 and K2 on the complement gives the C_(n,s) formula. The formal species of connected components gives the claimed bivariate exponential series and its specialization to the known univariate coefficient. A connected graph exists on each m>=3, but there is no graph without K1 or K2 components on m=1,2, proving the claimed support. The cases n=1,2 and the auxiliary n=0 term agree. At n=6 the listed class totals add to 31883 and their fiber-weighted sum is 32768.
residual_risks: The deduction uses the same labeled carrier and all same valuations, plus undirectedness and no loops; it neither tests model bisimilarity at one fixed valuation nor characterizes equality of frame-valid formulas.

value.rationale: This gives a concrete invariant of which adjacencies the non-contingency language can observe even under arbitrary nesting and all assignments, and a complete canonical representative plus depth-one separating test when equivalence fails. The matching fibers then describe all indistinguishable frames and their multiplicities, giving a use for the refined census beyond recomputing the known graph totals.
residual_risks: No claim that the bare enumeration or general bisimulation ideas are new; the result is not a quotient for directed or reflexive frames.
